title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)

messages.subject: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to present our competitive quote for your requirements. Our price is €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: part:370010 – price basis from 2027-01-01
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your offer and for your letter on the price basis.

Our orders with you for part:370010 rose from EUR 5.26 (po:4500013373-10) to EUR 5.84 (po:4500014427-10) between 2026-01-02 and 2026-09-18. That rise is already in our price.

AS-14404 fell from 3182.6744 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06) to 3007.8019 (idx:AS-14404@2026-09), a change of -5.49%.

PPI-C2431 fell from 131.9 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05) to 129.1 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08), a change of -2.12%.

The attached packages offer a two-year commitment, which gives you secure volume and planning. One package includes the AS-14404 clause you proposed. Which package suits your planning best, and is there a cheaper bar variant we should consider?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: part:370010 – price basis from 2027-01-01
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We acknowledge the recent index decreases you cited and have adjusted our offer accordingly. 

AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains. 

We welcome the 24-month commitment and the inclusion of the AS-14404 clause, which allows us to offer €5.30 per unit. Our offer provides a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: a price of €5.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Our offer is valid for 30 days.

Regarding your question about a cheaper bar variant, our technical team will reach out to discuss potential alternatives. From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.24 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.05 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.03 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: part:370010 - revised packages, 36-month option
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for the revised offer and for accepting the price history and index data we cited.

The forecast for part:370010 increased by 1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price.

You mentioned that you will focus on customers with volume. The attached packages now offer a 36-month commitment, which gives you longer planning security. One package keeps the AS-14404 clause with a deadband, so small index moves create no administrative work on either side.

Could your pricing committee review these packages at its next meeting? We would also welcome your earliest lead time and any cheaper bar variant you can suggest.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: part:370010 - revised packages, 36-month option
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your patience as we reviewed your request. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We appreciate the 36-month commitment and the inclusion of the AS-14404 index clause. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our offer is a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

By adjusting the payment terms to 30 days net, we can offer €5.30 per unit; our technical team will address your questions regarding lead times and material variants. As an alternative package, we offer a price of €5.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.24 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.05 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.03 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision.

Our offer is valid for 7 days. We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

Logistics: Please note that our standard Lieferzeit is 14 days, as we currently have free capacity for your parts. With overtime we can also deliver in 14 days, though this option comes at a premium.

messages.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)

We can accept your terms and await your order. We look forward to our continued cooperation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
